description: Fast product list with optional workspace/archive filters. Each row carries the product id used by autowhisper_cmo, its type, whether it has a main image, and its storefront link.

autowhisper_token.description: Optional: your AutoWhisper API token, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

limit.description: Maximum products to return, capped by the API.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to read. Omit for the user's CURRENT workspace — other workspaces are NOT included. Get other ids from autowhisper_status.

name: autowhisper_products
